programs.title: Uncle Buck
programs.desc: A bungling bachelor becomes a last-minute babysitter. Buck's brother's three children are foisted on him when the parents are called away from home indefinitely. Although he seems to be an unsuitable guardian, Buck turns out to have an unexpected knack for parenting, but he must work hard to prove himself, especially when he needs to save his eldest niece from her unsavoury boyfriend.

programs.title: Snow White And The Huntsman
programs.desc: An evil queen that has conquered much of England learns that her beautiful stepdaughter Snow White will surpass her as fairest in the kingdom and hires a hunter to kill her, but he ultimately aids Snow White in her campaign to kill her stepmother.

programs.title: M3GAN
programs.desc: When Gemma suddenly becomes the caretaker of her orphaned 8-year-old niece, Cady, she's unsure and unprepared to be a parent. Under intense pressure at work, Gemma decides to pair her M3GAN prototype with Cady in an attempt to resolve both problems, a decision that will have unimaginable consequences.
